intro.text: Hi friends! I'm Ozzy the owl! Let's learn about opposites! Ready? Let's go!
intro.speaker: character

outro.text: Big and small, up and down, you did it! Bye bye, friends!
outro.speaker: character

youtube.title: Opposites With Ozzy 🦉 Big and Small, Up and Down Song for Kids
youtube.description:
Big and small, fast and slow, loud and quiet! Learn opposites with Ozzy the owl in this fun sing-along for toddlers and preschoolers.
#opposites #kidssongs #nurseryrhymes #toddlerlearning #preschool
